ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity background (dark grey/black) with high-intensity (light grey/white) mottling across approximately 40% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Concentrated high-intensity pixel clusters surrounding the median notch, diffusing into irregular, high-contrast mottled patterns extending towards the lateral tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 75 degrees relative to the lobe midlines.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration across the entire trailing edge; notable macro-indentation (loss of edge continuity) on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve meeting a convex leading edge at acute, slightly rounded terminal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-intensity pixel clusters observed along the distal tips and sporadically along the trailing edge boundary.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinctive irregular indentation/notch on the trailing edge of the left lobe, indicating non-congenital tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique butterfly-shaped high-intensity pigmentation pattern bisected by the median notch.
